examples.en: Leo is the top banana at the café.

meaning.en: A top banana is the most important, powerful or highest-ranking person in a group, organisation or activity.
meaning.zh: top banana 指一個群體、機構或活動中最重要、最有權力或地位最高的人。

register.summaryEn: Top banana is informal and mainly associated with North American English. Oxford labels it informal and especially North American, while Collins describes it as slang and mainly American.
register.summaryZh: top banana 屬非正式用語，主要見於北美英語。 它通常帶有輕鬆、幽默或略帶戲謔的語氣。
contextsEn: friendly discussions about a club or team
serious announcements in which the person’s real title is important
register.formalEn: employment contracts; formal company reports; official organisation charts; legal documents; serious announcements in which the person’s real title is important.
register.formalZh: 在合約、正式公司報告、組織架構圖、法律文件或需要準確列明職銜的公告中，應使用 manager、 director、chairperson、team leader 等正式名稱。

benefits.en: This expression can show who truly controls a group, even when several people have impressive titles.
benefits.zh: 這個表達可以指出誰真正控制團隊，即使其他人亦擁有看似重要的職銜。

benefits.titleEn: It Gives a Playful Alternative to “Boss”
benefits.en: Top banana can make a description sound lighter or more humorous than boss, director or leader.
benefits.zh: 與 boss、director 或 leader 相比，top banana 可以令說法較輕鬆或幽默。

benefits.titleEn: It Works in Several Grammatical Positions
benefits.en: after a linking verb; after a modal; as an object complement; with a possessive; in apposition; in a question; inside a contrast or condition.
benefits.zh: 學生不需要把它永遠放在同一位置，而可以根據句子功能改變外圍文法。

benefits.titleEn: It Helps Discuss Changes in Leadership
benefits.en: become; remain; used to be; will be; may become; no longer be.
benefits.zh: 它可以用來談論取得權力、保持地位、失去領導位置及未來接班等情況。

benefits.titleEn: It Can Distinguish Real Power from an Official Title
benefits.titleZh: 這個表達可以用來比較名義上的領袖和真正掌權的人
benefits.en: James may officially be top banana, but his assistant makes the real decisions.
benefits.zh: 這個表達可以用來比較名義上的領袖和真正掌權的人。

benefits.en: Top banana is memorable and useful, but it is not automatically better than a formal title.
benefits.zh: 學生需要判斷何時適合使用幽默、非正式表達，何時應使用 manager、director 或 chairperson 等正式字眼。

origin.statusEn: Well-Documented Theatrical Development; Exact Stage Story Uncertain
origin.statusZh: 劇場用法的演變有較充分記錄；確切舞台故事仍未完全確定

history.en: The leading comedian was the most important comic performer in the show. Top banana therefore developed naturally from “the star comedian” to “the leader or most important person in any group”.
history.zh: 首席喜劇演員是表演中最重要的喜劇角色，因此 top banana 的意思自然由「首席喜劇演員」擴展至「任何群體中的領袖或最重要人物」。

origin.memoryEn: The top performer became the top banana; today, the top person in a group can still be called the top banana.
origin.memoryZh: 最重要的表演者曾被稱為 top banana；今天，一個群體中地位最高的人仍可被稱為 top banana。

rules.titleZh: 黃女士是部門內的最高話事人
rules.zh: 黃女士是部門內的最高話事人。 這個國家是最大的香蕉生產國。

examples.en: Ms Wong is the top banana in the department.
examples.zh: 黃女士是部門內的最高話事人。

examples.en: This country is the top banana producer.
examples.zh: 這個國家是最大的香蕉生產國。

rules.titleEn: The Person Must Have the Highest Position or
rules.en: A popular, experienced or talented person is not automatically the top banana.
rules.zh: 受歡迎、經驗豐富或能力出眾的人，不一定是最高話事人。 語境必須顯示對方擁有最高地位或實際決策權。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Confuse It with “Second Banana”
rules.en: Second banana means a person in a supporting or less important position. The two expressions developed from the ranking of performers in American show business.
rules.zh: top banana 指首要人物； second banana 則指處於次要或輔助地位的人。
